info.name: Swazei Multi-Tenant POS - Platform to Store Flow
info.description: Platform onboarding and merchant/store-scoped operations. Each merchant and each store has its own folder in every applicable section.

request.description: Set platformAdminEmail and platformAdminPassword to PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAIL and PLATFORM_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the server .env, then log in.

item.name: Create Merchant A and first merchant admin

request.description: Platform-admin operation. Creates Merchant A and its first merchant admin in one transaction.
Log in the first admin created for Merchant A.
A tenant admin can list only its own merchant.

exec: pm.test('only lists Merchant A', () => { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(rows[0].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('merchantAId')); });

request.description: Read the merchant belonging to the authenticated admin.

item.name: Create Merchant B and first merchant admin

request.description: Platform-admin operation. Creates a separate merchant and its first admin.

exec: pm.test('creates a distinct Merchant B admin', () => { pm.expect(body.merchant.id).not.to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('merchantAId')); pm.expect(body.admin.role).to.eql('merchant_admin'); pm.expect(body.admin.merchantId).to.eql(body.merchant.id); });

request.description: Log in the first admin created for Merchant B.
A tenant admin can list only its own merchant.

exec: pm.test('only lists Merchant B', () => { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(rows[0].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('merchantBId')); });

request.description: Read the merchant belonging to the authenticated admin.
Merchant A admin creates Store A1.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('store belongs to Merchant A', () => pm.expect(body.merchantId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('merchantAId')));

request.description: Read Store A1 as its merchant admin.
Merchant A admin creates its second store.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('store belongs to Merchant A', () => pm.expect(body.merchantId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('merchantAId')));

request.description: Read Store A2 as its merchant admin.
Merchant A admin sees both of its stores.

exec: pm.test('lists only the two Merchant A stores', () => { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(rows.map(x => x.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeA1Id')); pm.expect(rows.map(x => x.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeA2Id')); });

request.description: Merchant B admin creates Store B1, isolated from Merchant A.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('store belongs to Merchant B', () => pm.expect(body.merchantId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('merchantBId')));

request.description: Read Store B1 as its merchant admin.
Merchant B admin creates its second store.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('store belongs to Merchant B', () => pm.expect(body.merchantId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('merchantBId')));

request.description: Read Store B2 as its merchant admin.
Merchant B admin sees both of its stores.

exec: pm.test('lists only the two Merchant B stores', () => { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(rows.map(x => x.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeB1Id')); pm.expect(rows.map(x => x.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeB2Id')); });

request.description: Merchant A admin creates staff assigned only to Store A1; the server assigns store_staff role.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('staff is scoped to Store A1', () => { pm.expect(body.role).to.eql('store_staff'); pm.expect(body.storeId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeA1Id')); pm.expect(body.merchantId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('merchantAId')); });

request.description: Log in as Store A1 staff and save the store-only token.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('login is Store A1 staff', () => { pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('store_staff'); pm.expect(body.user.storeId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeA1Id')); });

request.description: Merchant A admin reads the created Store A1 staff record.
Merchant A admin creates a separate staff account for Store A2.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('staff is scoped to Store A2', () => { pm.expect(body.role).to.eql('store_staff'); pm.expect(body.storeId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeA2Id')); });

request.description: Log in as Store A2 staff and save its separate token.
Read the staff account assigned to Store A2.
Merchant A admin lists only its owner account and two store staff.

exec: pm.test('lists three Merchant A users', () => { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.have.length(3); pm.expect(rows.every(x => x.merchantId === pm.collectionVariables.get('merchantAId'))).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Merchant B admin creates staff assigned to Store B1.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('staff is scoped to Store B1', () => { pm.expect(body.role).to.eql('store_staff'); pm.expect(body.storeId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeB1Id')); });

request.description: Log in as Store B1 staff and save its separate token.
Read the staff account assigned to Store B1.
Merchant B admin creates staff assigned to Store B2.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('staff is scoped to Store B2', () => { pm.expect(body.role).to.eql('store_staff'); pm.expect(body.storeId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeB2Id')); });

request.description: Log in as Store B2 staff and save its separate token.
Read the staff account assigned to Store B2.
Merchant B admin lists only its owner account and two store staff.

exec: pm.test('lists Merchant B users', () => { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.have.length(3); pm.expect(rows.every(x => x.merchantId === pm.collectionVariables.get('merchantBId'))).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Merchant A admin creates a product in Store A1; inventory starts at zero.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('product belongs to Store A1', () => pm.expect(body.storeId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeA1Id')));

request.description: Store A1 staff lists products and their inventory.

exec: pm.test('includes the Store A1 product and inventory', () => { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows.some(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('productA1Id'))).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Store A1 staff reads its store's product by ID.
Merchant A admin updates the product name in Store A1.

exec: pm.test('updates product name', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql('Updated Coffee A1 ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')));

request.description: Merchant A admin creates a separate product in Store A2.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('product belongs to Store A2', () => pm.expect(body.storeId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeA2Id')));

request.description: Store A2 staff lists products and their inventory.
Store A2 staff reads its store's product by ID.
Update the product assigned to Store A2.

exec: pm.test('updates product name', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql('Updated Coffee A1 ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')));

request.description: Merchant B admin creates a product in Store B1.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('product belongs to Store B1', () => pm.expect(body.storeId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeB1Id')));

request.description: Store B1 staff lists products and their inventory.
Store B1 staff reads its store's product by ID.
Update the product assigned to Store B1.

exec: pm.test('updates product name', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql('Updated Coffee A1 ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')));

request.description: Merchant B admin creates a product in Store B2.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('product belongs to Store B2', () => pm.expect(body.storeId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('storeB2Id')));

request.description: Store B2 staff lists products and their inventory.
Store B2 staff reads its store's product by ID.
Update the product assigned to Store B2.

exec: pm.test('updates product name', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql('Updated Coffee A1 ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')));

request.description: Merchant A admin receives ten units for the Store A1 product.
Store A1 staff reads inventory; save the initial stock for the sale assertion.

exec: const row = pm.response.json().find(x => x.productId === pm.collectionVariables.get('productA1Id')); pm.test('contains Store A1 product inventory', () => pm.expect(row).to.be.an('object'));

request.description: Merchant A admin receives stock for Store A2 product.
Store A2 staff reads inventory; save the initial stock for the sale assertion.

exec: const row = pm.response.json().find(i => i.productId === pm.collectionVariables.get('productA2Id')); pm.test('includes inventory for Store A2', () => pm.expect(row).to.be.an('object'));

request.description: Merchant B admin receives stock for Store B1 product.
Store B1 staff reads inventory; save the initial stock for the sale assertion.

exec: const row = pm.response.json().find(i => i.productId === pm.collectionVariables.get('productB1Id')); pm.test('includes inventory for Store B1', () => pm.expect(row).to.be.an('object'));

request.description: Merchant B admin receives stock for Store B2 product.
Store B2 staff reads inventory; save the initial stock for the sale assertion.

exec: const row = pm.response.json().find(i => i.productId === pm.collectionVariables.get('productB2Id')); pm.test('includes inventory for Store B2', () => pm.expect(row).to.be.an('object'));

request.description: Store A1 staff creates a POS sale for its own product.
Store A1 staff lists sales for its assigned store.

exec: pm.test('includes the created sale', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('saleId') || x.saleId === pm.collectionVariables.get('saleId'))).to.eql(true));
